clauses.clause: Figures share the heroine's proportions and absolute height (no shrunken adults), accessories on heads, held props in hands, sitters on seats.
clauses.note: Fresh low/high pooled WebGL2 fixtures; opened all22 original1280x720 images. Six zoo-staff/visitor identities retain coherent body proportions and hand-held bag/phone/coffee/watering-can; former bag/phone forearm fans are absent in both close views. Five adult bases beside the heroine at the same ground plane show comparable absolute height and head/body proportions, without miniature adults. Four hat/accessory examples stay on heads. Three seat types plus four named-character sitters (7 seated actors per tier) remain on their bench/chair surfaces; no hovering torso or seat penetration is established in close and wide views. Zero browser errors in all6 receipts. Repro: blk-v-captures.mjs G26 rr-b low/high; test-results/rr-b/g26-complement.mjs low/high; test-results/rr-b/g26-wide.mjs low/high, each with BROWSER_POOL_JOB_ID=rr-b and a private SCENE_PORT.
